The transparent material used to make windows is glass.

Antioxidants are molecules that inhibit the oxidation of other molecules. Oxidation is a chemical reaction that can produce free radicals, leading to chain reactions that may damage the cells of organisms. Antioxidants such as thiols or ascorbic acid (vitamin C) terminate these chain reactions by removing free radical intermediates, and inhibit other oxidation reactions. They are often found in fruits and vegetables, and they offer health benefits by protecting cells from damage caused by unstable molecules known as free radicals, potentially reducing the risk of chronic diseases such as heart disease and cancer.
